source_records.text: In the first year of Baltasar’s reign over the country of Babylonia, Daniel saw a vision at his head upon his bed. Then Daniel wrote the vision he had seen in principal points:
source_records.display_text: In the first year of Baltasar’s reign over the country of Babylonia, Daniel saw a vision at his head upon his bed. Then Daniel wrote the vision he had seen in principal points:

source_records.text: “Upon my bed I was watching in dreams by night, and there were four winds of heaven falling upon the great sea.
source_records.display_text: “Upon my bed I was watching in dreams by night, and there were four winds of heaven falling upon the great sea.

source_records.text: Four beasts came up from the sea, each differing from the other.
source_records.display_text: Four beasts came up from the sea, each differing from the other.

source_records.text: The first was like a lioness with wings like an eagle’s. I watched until her wings were plucked out, she was lifted from the earth and stood on human feet, and a human heart was given her.
source_records.display_text: The first was like a lioness with wings like an eagle’s. I watched until her wings were plucked out, she was lifted from the earth and stood on human feet, and a human heart was given her.

source_records.text: After her there was another beast with the likeness of a bear. It stood on one side and had three ribs in its mouth. He spoke in this way: ‘Rise, devour much flesh!’
source_records.display_text: After her there was another beast with the likeness of a bear. It stood on one side and had three ribs in its mouth. He spoke in this way: ‘Rise, devour much flesh!’

source_records.text: After this I watched another beast, like a leopard. Four wings stretched over it, and the beast had four heads; a tongue was given it.
source_records.display_text: After this I watched another beast, like a leopard. Four wings stretched over it, and the beast had four heads; a tongue was given it.

source_records.text: After this I watched in the night vision a fourth beast, fearsome, its terror surpassing in strength. It had great iron teeth, devoured and pounded, trampled all around with its feet, and acted differently from all the beasts before it. It had ten horns,
source_records.display_text: After this I watched in the night vision a fourth beast, fearsome, its terror surpassing in strength. It had great iron teeth, devoured and pounded, trampled all around with its feet, and acted differently from all the beasts before it. It had ten horns,

source_records.text: and many plans were in its horns. Another single horn sprouted among them, small among its horns, and three of the earlier horns were withered through it. This horn had eyes like human eyes and a mouth speaking great things, and it made war against the holy ones.
source_records.display_text: and many plans were in its horns. Another single horn sprouted among them, small among its horns, and three of the earlier horns were withered through it. This horn had eyes like human eyes and a mouth speaking great things, and it made war against the holy ones.

source_records.text: I watched until thrones were set in place and an Ancient of Days was seated, wearing a covering like snow, with the hair of His head like pure white wool. The throne was like a flame of fire,
source_records.display_text: I watched until thrones were set in place and an Ancient of Days was seated, wearing a covering like snow, with the hair of His head like pure white wool. The throne was like a flame of fire,

source_records.text: and a river of fire came out before Him. A thousand thousands attended Him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood beside Him. A court sat, and books were opened.
source_records.display_text: and a river of fire came out before Him. A thousand thousands attended Him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood beside Him. A court sat, and books were opened.

source_records.text: Then I watched the sound of the great words the horn was speaking. The beast was beaten to death, its body perished, and it was given over to burning fire.
source_records.display_text: Then I watched the sound of the great words the horn was speaking. The beast was beaten to death, its body perished, and it was given over to burning fire.

source_records.text: He removed those around it from their authority, and a span of life was given them for a time and a season.
source_records.display_text: He removed those around it from their authority, and a span of life was given them for a time and a season.

source_records.text: I watched in the night vision, and there, upon the clouds of heaven, one like a son of man was coming. He was present as an Ancient of Days, and those standing by were present with him.
source_records.display_text: I watched in the night vision, and there, upon the clouds of heaven, one like a son of man was coming. He was present as an Ancient of Days, and those standing by were present with him.

source_records.text: Authority was given him, and all the nations of the earth according to their families, and all glory, worshipped him. His authority is everlasting authority that will never be taken away, and his kingdom will never be destroyed.
source_records.display_text: Authority was given him, and all the nations of the earth according to their families, and all glory, worshipped him. His authority is everlasting authority that will never be taken away, and his kingdom will never be destroyed.

source_records.text: I, Daniel, was disheartened by these things in the night vision,
source_records.display_text: I, Daniel, was disheartened by these things in the night vision,

source_records.text: and approached one of those standing there, seeking exact understanding from him concerning all these things. He answered me and explained the judgment of the words:
source_records.display_text: and approached one of those standing there, seeking exact understanding from him concerning all these things. He answered me and explained the judgment of the words:

source_records.text: ‘These great beasts are four kingdoms that will perish from the earth.
source_records.display_text: ‘These great beasts are four kingdoms that will perish from the earth.

source_records.text: The holy ones of the Most High will receive the kingdom and hold the kingdom for ever, for the age of ages.’
source_records.display_text: The holy ones of the Most High will receive the kingdom and hold the kingdom for ever, for the age of ages.’

source_records.text: Then I wanted exact understanding of the fourth beast, which destroyed everything and was exceedingly fearsome. Its teeth were iron and its claws bronze, devouring everyone all around and trampling with its feet,
source_records.display_text: Then I wanted exact understanding of the fourth beast, which destroyed everything and was exceedingly fearsome. Its teeth were iron and its claws bronze, devouring everyone all around and trampling with its feet,

source_records.text: and of its ten horns upon its head and the single other that sprouted, through which three fell out. That horn had eyes and a mouth speaking great things, and its appearance surpassed the others.
source_records.display_text: and of its ten horns upon its head and the single other that sprouted, through which three fell out. That horn had eyes and a mouth speaking great things, and its appearance surpassed the others.

source_records.text: I observed that horn waging war against the holy ones and routing them,
source_records.display_text: I observed that horn waging war against the holy ones and routing them,

source_records.text: until the Ancient of Days came and gave judgment to the holy ones of the Most High. The time was given, and the holy ones took possession of the kingship.
source_records.display_text: until the Ancient of Days came and gave judgment to the holy ones of the Most High. The time was given, and the holy ones took possession of the kingship.

source_records.text: I was told concerning the fourth beast that a fourth kingdom would be upon the earth, surpassing the whole earth, overturning it and grinding it down.
source_records.display_text: I was told concerning the fourth beast that a fourth kingdom would be upon the earth, surpassing the whole earth, overturning it and grinding it down.

source_records.text: As for the kingdom’s ten horns, ten kings will arise, and another king will arise after them. He will surpass the earlier ones in evils and humble three kings.
source_records.display_text: As for the kingdom’s ten horns, ten kings will arise, and another king will arise after them. He will surpass the earlier ones in evils and humble three kings.

source_records.text: He will speak words against the Most High, wear down the holy ones of the Most High, and expect to alter seasons and law. Everything will be handed into his hands for a time, times, and half a time.
source_records.display_text: He will speak words against the Most High, wear down the holy ones of the Most High, and expect to alter seasons and law. Everything will be handed into his hands for a time, times, and half a time.

source_records.text: The judgment will sit; they will destroy the authority and plan to defile and destroy completely.
source_records.display_text: The judgment will sit; they will destroy the authority and plan to defile and destroy completely.

source_records.text: He gave the kingdom, authority, their greatness, and rule over all the kingdoms under heaven to a holy people of the Most High, to reign with everlasting kingship; all authorities will be subject to him and obey him.
source_records.display_text: He gave the kingdom, authority, their greatness, and rule over all the kingdoms under heaven to a holy people of the Most High, to reign with everlasting kingship; all authorities will be subject to him and obey him.

source_records.text: Until the account ended, I, Daniel, was greatly overcome with astonishment; my condition changed, and I fixed the matter in my heart.”
source_records.display_text: Until the account ended, I, Daniel, was greatly overcome with astonishment; my condition changed, and I fixed the matter in my heart.”

source_records.text: In the third year of Baltasar’s reign came the vision that I, Daniel, saw after seeing the first one.
source_records.display_text: In the third year of Baltasar’s reign came the vision that I, Daniel, saw after seeing the first one.

source_records.text: I saw in the vision of my dream, while I was in the city of Susa in the country of Elymais, still beside the gate of Ailam,
source_records.display_text: I saw in the vision of my dream, while I was in the city of Susa in the country of Elymais, still beside the gate of Ailam,

source_records.text: that, looking up, I saw a great ram standing opposite the gate. It had horns, one higher than the other, and the higher one was rising.
source_records.display_text: that, looking up, I saw a great ram standing opposite the gate. It had horns, one higher than the other, and the higher one was rising.

source_records.text: After this I saw the ram charging eastward, northward, westward, and southward. No animals stood before it, and no one rescued from its hands. It did as it wished and was exalted.
source_records.display_text: After this I saw the ram charging eastward, northward, westward, and southward. No animals stood before it, and no one rescued from its hands. It did as it wished and was exalted.

source_records.text: I was pondering, and a male goat came from the west over the earth’s surface without touching the earth. The goat had a single horn between its eyes.
source_records.display_text: I was pondering, and a male goat came from the west over the earth’s surface without touching the earth. The goat had a single horn between its eyes.

source_records.text: It came against the horned ram that I had seen standing beside the gate and ran at it in furious anger.
source_records.display_text: It came against the horned ram that I had seen standing beside the gate and ran at it in furious anger.

source_records.text: I saw it approach the ram, become furious with it, strike it, and shatter its two horns. The ram no longer had strength to stand against the goat. It hurled the ram down upon the earth and crushed it, and no one could rescue the ram from the goat.
source_records.display_text: I saw it approach the ram, become furious with it, strike it, and shatter its two horns. The ram no longer had strength to stand against the goat. It hurled the ram down upon the earth and crushed it, and no one could rescue the ram from the goat.

source_records.text: The male goat grew exceedingly strong. When it became strong, its great horn was shattered, and four other horns rose behind it toward the four winds of heaven.
source_records.display_text: The male goat grew exceedingly strong. When it became strong, its great horn was shattered, and four other horns rose behind it toward the four winds of heaven.

source_records.text: From one of them a single strong horn sprouted. It grew strong and struck toward the south, toward the east, and toward the north.
source_records.display_text: From one of them a single strong horn sprouted. It grew strong and struck toward the south, toward the east, and toward the north.

source_records.text: It was raised as high as heaven’s stars, but was dashed to the earth from the stars and trampled by them,
source_records.display_text: It was raised as high as heaven’s stars, but was dashed to the earth from the stars and trampled by them,

source_records.text: until the chief commander rescues the captivity. Because of him the ancient mountains were dashed down; their place and sacrifice were removed. He set it down upon the earth, and it prospered and came to pass, and the sanctuary will be made desolate.
source_records.display_text: until the chief commander rescues the captivity. Because of him the ancient mountains were dashed down; their place and sacrifice were removed. He set it down upon the earth, and it prospered and came to pass, and the sanctuary will be made desolate.

source_records.text: Sins came upon the sacrifice; righteousness was thrown down to the ground, and he acted and prospered.
source_records.display_text: Sins came upon the sacrifice; righteousness was thrown down to the ground, and he acted and prospered.

source_records.text: I heard another holy one speaking, and the other said to the speaking Phelmouni, “How long will the vision stand, and the sacrifice that was removed, and the sin of desolation that was given, and the holy places be made desolate for trampling?”
source_records.display_text: I heard another holy one speaking, and the other said to the speaking Phelmouni, “How long will the vision stand, and the sacrifice that was removed, and the sin of desolation that was given, and the holy places be made desolate for trampling?”

source_records.text: He said to him, “Until evening and morning, two thousand three hundred days; then the sanctuary will be cleansed.”
source_records.display_text: He said to him, “Until evening and morning, two thousand three hundred days; then the sanctuary will be cleansed.”

source_records.text: As I, Daniel, watched the vision, I sought to understand, and there stood opposite me someone with a human appearance.
source_records.display_text: As I, Daniel, watched the vision, I sought to understand, and there stood opposite me someone with a human appearance.

source_records.text: I heard a human voice in the midst of Ulai, calling, “Gabriel, give that one understanding of the vision.” The man cried out and said, “The vision concerns that command.”
source_records.display_text: I heard a human voice in the midst of Ulai, calling, “Gabriel, give that one understanding of the vision.” The man cried out and said, “The vision concerns that command.”

source_records.text: He came and stood beside where I stood. As he came, I was disturbed and fell upon my face. He said to me, “Understand, son of man, for this vision is still for an appointed hour.”
source_records.display_text: He came and stood beside where I stood. As he came, I was disturbed and fell upon my face. He said to me, “Understand, son of man, for this vision is still for an appointed hour.”

source_records.text: As he spoke with me, I fell asleep face down on the ground. He touched me and raised me on the spot,
source_records.display_text: As he spoke with me, I fell asleep face down on the ground. He touched me and raised me on the spot,

source_records.text: and said to me, “Behold! I am reporting what will happen at the end of the wrath to the sons of your people; it will still remain until the hours of the appointed time of completion.
source_records.display_text: and said to me, “Behold! I am reporting what will happen at the end of the wrath to the sons of your people; it will still remain until the hours of the appointed time of completion.

source_records.text: The ram you saw with the horns is the king of the Medes and Persians.
source_records.display_text: The ram you saw with the horns is the king of the Medes and Persians.

source_records.text: The male goat is the king of the Greeks, and the great horn between its eyes is the first king himself.
source_records.display_text: The male goat is the king of the Greeks, and the great horn between its eyes is the first king himself.

source_records.text: As for the four horns that were shattered and rose behind it, four kings of his nation will arise, but not according to his strength.
source_records.display_text: As for the four horns that were shattered and rose behind it, four kings of his nation will arise, but not according to his strength.

source_records.text: At the end of their kingship, when their sins reach fullness, a king with a shameless face who understands riddles will arise.
source_records.display_text: At the end of their kingship, when their sins reach fullness, a king with a shameless face who understands riddles will arise.

source_records.text: His strength will be made firm, though not by his own strength. He will destroy astonishingly, prosper, and act; he will destroy rulers and a people of holy ones.
source_records.display_text: His strength will be made firm, though not by his own strength. He will destroy astonishingly, prosper, and act; he will destroy rulers and a people of holy ones.

source_records.text: His intent will be against the holy ones; falsehood will prosper in his hands, and his heart will be exalted. By deceit he will make many disappear, rise for the destruction of men, make a “gathering of a hand,” and sell.
source_records.display_text: His intent will be against the holy ones; falsehood will prosper in his hands, and his heart will be exalted. By deceit he will make many disappear, rise for the destruction of men, make a “gathering of a hand,” and sell.

source_records.text: The evening-and-morning vision was found to be true. Now the vision is closed up, for it is still for many days.”
source_records.display_text: The evening-and-morning vision was found to be true. Now the vision is closed up, for it is still for many days.”

source_records.text: I, Daniel, was weak for many days. Then I rose and again conducted royal affairs. I was undone by the vision, and there was no one who understood.
source_records.display_text: I, Daniel, was weak for many days. Then I rose and again conducted royal affairs. I was undone by the vision, and there was no one who understood.

source_records.text: In the first year under Darius son of Xerxes, from the Median family who ruled over the kingdom of the Chaldeans,
source_records.display_text: In the first year under Darius son of Xerxes, from the Median family who ruled over the kingdom of the Chaldeans,

source_records.text: in the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, considered in the books the number of years, when a command came to the land concerning Jeremiah the prophet, to bring Jerusalem’s reproach to its full term: seventy years.
source_records.display_text: in the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, considered in the books the number of years, when a command came to the land concerning Jeremiah the prophet, to bring Jerusalem’s reproach to its full term: seventy years.

source_records.text: I set my face toward the Lord God to find prayer and mercy, with fasts, sackcloth, and ashes.
source_records.display_text: I set my face toward the Lord God to find prayer and mercy, with fasts, sackcloth, and ashes.

source_records.text: I prayed to the Lord God and confessed, saying, “Behold, Lord, Thou art the great, strong, and fearsome God, keeping the covenant and mercy for those who love Thee and guard Thy commands:
source_records.display_text: I prayed to the Lord God and confessed, saying, “Behold, Lord, Thou art the great, strong, and fearsome God, keeping the covenant and mercy for those who love Thee and guard Thy commands:

source_records.text: we have sinned, done wrong, acted impiously, fallen away, and transgressed Thy commandments and judgments,
source_records.display_text: we have sinned, done wrong, acted impiously, fallen away, and transgressed Thy commandments and judgments,

source_records.text: and have not listened to Thy servants the prophets, to what they spoke in Thy name to our kings, our rulers, our fathers, and every nation upon the earth.
source_records.display_text: and have not listened to Thy servants the prophets, to what they spoke in Thy name to our kings, our rulers, our fathers, and every nation upon the earth.

source_records.text: Righteousness belongs to Thee, Lord, but shame of face to us as on this day—to the people of Judah, those dwelling in Jerusalem, and all the people Israel, near and far, in all the countries where Thou didst scatter them because of the trespass they committed before Thee.
source_records.display_text: Righteousness belongs to Thee, Lord, but shame of face to us as on this day—to the people of Judah, those dwelling in Jerusalem, and all the people Israel, near and far, in all the countries where Thou didst scatter them because of the trespass they committed before Thee.

source_records.text: Master, shame of face belongs to us, to our kings, rulers, and fathers, because we have sinned against Thee.
source_records.display_text: Master, shame of face belongs to us, to our kings, rulers, and fathers, because we have sinned against Thee.

source_records.text: To the Lord belong righteousness and mercy, for we have fallen away from Thee
source_records.display_text: To the Lord belong righteousness and mercy, for we have fallen away from Thee

source_records.text: and have not listened to the voice of the Lord our God, to follow Thy law that Thou didst set before Moses and us through Thy servants the prophets.
source_records.display_text: and have not listened to the voice of the Lord our God, to follow Thy law that Thou didst set before Moses and us through Thy servants the prophets.

source_records.text: All Israel abandoned Thy law and fell away, refusing to hear Thy voice. The curse and oath written in the law of Moses, God’s servant, came upon us, because we sinned against Him.
source_records.display_text: All Israel abandoned Thy law and fell away, refusing to hear Thy voice. The curse and oath written in the law of Moses, God’s servant, came upon us, because we sinned against Him.

source_records.text: He established for us His commands, all He spoke against us and against our judges, all Thou didst judge for us, bringing great calamities upon us, such as had not occurred under heaven as occurred in Jerusalem.
source_records.display_text: He established for us His commands, all He spoke against us and against our judges, all Thou didst judge for us, bringing great calamities upon us, such as had not occurred under heaven as occurred in Jerusalem.

source_records.text: According to what is written in Moses’ covenant, all the calamities came upon us. Yet we did not seek the face of the Lord our God by departing from our sins and understanding Thy righteousness, Lord.
source_records.display_text: According to what is written in Moses’ covenant, all the calamities came upon us. Yet we did not seek the face of the Lord our God by departing from our sins and understanding Thy righteousness, Lord.

source_records.text: The Lord God kept watch over the calamities and brought them upon us, for the Lord our God is righteous in everything He may do, and we did not listen to His voice.
source_records.display_text: The Lord God kept watch over the calamities and brought them upon us, for the Lord our God is righteous in everything He may do, and we did not listen to His voice.

source_records.text: Now, Master, Lord our God, who didst bring Thy people out of Egypt with Thine uplifted arm and didst make Thyself a name as on this day: we have sinned and acted in ignorance.
source_records.display_text: Now, Master, Lord our God, who didst bring Thy people out of Egypt with Thine uplifted arm and didst make Thyself a name as on this day: we have sinned and acted in ignorance.

source_records.text: Master, according to Thy righteousness, let Thy wrath and anger turn away from Thy city Jerusalem, Thy holy mountain. Because of our sins and our fathers’ acts of ignorance, Jerusalem and Thy people, Lord, are a reproach among all around us.
source_records.display_text: Master, according to Thy righteousness, let Thy wrath and anger turn away from Thy city Jerusalem, Thy holy mountain. Because of our sins and our fathers’ acts of ignorance, Jerusalem and Thy people, Lord, are a reproach among all around us.

source_records.text: Now, Master, hear Thy servant’s prayer and my supplications. Let Thy face look upon Thy desolate holy mountain, for Thy servants’ sake, Master.
source_records.display_text: Now, Master, hear Thy servant’s prayer and my supplications. Let Thy face look upon Thy desolate holy mountain, for Thy servants’ sake, Master.

source_records.text: Attend with Thine ear, Lord, and hear me. Open Thine eyes and see our desolation and that of Thy city, over which Thy name has been called. For we make our supplication in our prayers before Thee because of Thy mercy, not our righteous deeds.
source_records.display_text: Attend with Thine ear, Lord, and hear me. Open Thine eyes and see our desolation and that of Thy city, over which Thy name has been called. For we make our supplication in our prayers before Thee because of Thy mercy, not our righteous deeds.

source_records.text: Lord, be propitious! Lord, hear and act, and do not delay, for Thine own sake, Master, because Thy name has been called over Thy city Zion and Thy people Israel.”
source_records.display_text: Lord, be propitious! Lord, hear and act, and do not delay, for Thine own sake, Master, because Thy name has been called over Thy city Zion and Thy people Israel.”

source_records.text: While I was speaking in prayer, confessing my sins and the sins of my people Israel, and making supplication in prayers before the Lord my God and on behalf of our God’s holy mountain,
source_records.display_text: While I was speaking in prayer, confessing my sins and the sins of my people Israel, and making supplication in prayers before the Lord my God and on behalf of our God’s holy mountain,

source_records.text: while I was still speaking in my prayer, the man I had seen at first in my sleep, Gabriel, was carried swiftly and approached me at the hour of the evening sacrifice.
source_records.display_text: while I was still speaking in my prayer, the man I had seen at first in my sleep, Gabriel, was carried swiftly and approached me at the hour of the evening sacrifice.

source_records.text: He approached and spoke with me, saying, “Daniel, I have just come out to show you understanding.
source_records.display_text: He approached and spoke with me, saying, “Daniel, I have just come out to show you understanding.

source_records.text: At the beginning of your supplication, a command went out from the Lord, and I came to explain it to you, because you are worthy of pity. Understand the command.
source_records.display_text: At the beginning of your supplication, a command went out from the Lord, and I came to explain it to you, because you are worthy of pity. Understand the command.

source_records.text: Seventy weeks have been determined for your people and the city Zion: for sin to be brought to completion, injustices to become scarce, injustices to be wiped away, the vision to be understood, everlasting righteousness to be given, the vision to be fulfilled, and a holy of holies to be gladdened.
source_records.display_text: Seventy weeks have been determined for your people and the city Zion: for sin to be brought to completion, injustices to become scarce, injustices to be wiped away, the vision to be understood, everlasting righteousness to be given, the vision to be fulfilled, and a holy of holies to be gladdened.

source_records.text: You will know, understand, and rejoice. You will find commands to be answered, and you will build Jerusalem as a city for the Lord.
source_records.display_text: You will know, understand, and rejoice. You will find commands to be answered, and you will build Jerusalem as a city for the Lord.

source_records.text: After seven and seventy and sixty-two, an anointing will be removed and no longer exist. A kingdom of nations will destroy the city and sanctuary together with the anointed one. Its completion will come with wrath and last until the time of completion; it will be assailed by war.
source_records.display_text: After seven and seventy and sixty-two, an anointing will be removed and no longer exist. A kingdom of nations will destroy the city and sanctuary together with the anointed one. Its completion will come with wrath and last until the time of completion; it will be assailed by war.

source_records.text: The covenant will prevail for many. It will return again and be rebuilt in breadth and length. At the completion of times, after seven and seventy periods and sixty-two years, until the time of the completion of war, desolation will be removed when the covenant grows strong for many weeks. At the end of the week the sacrifice and libation will be removed. Upon the temple will be an abomination of desolations until completion, and completion will be given upon the desolation.”
source_records.display_text: The covenant will prevail for many. It will return again and be rebuilt in breadth and length. At the completion of times, after seven and seventy periods and sixty-two years, until the time of the completion of war, desolation will be removed when the covenant grows strong for many weeks. At the end of the week the sacrifice and libation will be removed. Upon the temple will be an abomination of desolations until completion, and completion will be given upon the desolation.”

source_records.text: In the first year of Cyrus, king of the Persians, a command was shown to Daniel, whose name was called Baltasar. The vision and command were true, and the strong multitude will understand the command; I understood it in a vision.
source_records.display_text: In the first year of Cyrus, king of the Persians, a command was shown to Daniel, whose name was called Baltasar. The vision and command were true, and the strong multitude will understand the command; I understood it in a vision.

source_records.text: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning for three weeks.
source_records.display_text: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning for three weeks.

source_records.text: I ate no desirable bread; meat and wine did not enter my mouth, and I did not anoint myself with oil until I completed the three weeks of days.
source_records.display_text: I ate no desirable bread; meat and wine did not enter my mouth, and I did not anoint myself with oil until I completed the three weeks of days.

source_records.text: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was on the bank of the great river, the Tigris,
source_records.display_text: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was on the bank of the great river, the Tigris,

source_records.text: and I lifted my eyes and saw a man clothed in fine linen, with fine linen wrapped around his waist, and light coming from his middle.
source_records.display_text: and I lifted my eyes and saw a man clothed in fine linen, with fine linen wrapped around his waist, and light coming from his middle.

source_records.text: His body was like a tarshish stone, his face like a flash of lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, his arms and feet like flashing bronze, and the sound of his speech like the sound of an uproar.
source_records.display_text: His body was like a tarshish stone, his face like a flash of lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, his arms and feet like flashing bronze, and the sound of his speech like the sound of an uproar.

source_records.text: I, Daniel, saw this great vision, but the men with me did not see it. Strong fear fell upon them, and they fled in haste.
source_records.display_text: I, Daniel, saw this great vision, but the men with me did not see it. Strong fear fell upon them, and they fled in haste.

source_records.text: I was left alone and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; a spirit turned upon me for destruction, and I had no strength.
source_records.display_text: I was left alone and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; a spirit turned upon me for destruction, and I had no strength.

source_records.text: I did not hear the sound of his speech; I had fallen face down upon the earth.

source_records.text: He brought a hand toward me and raised me upon my knees, upon the soles of my feet.

source_records.text: He said to me, “Daniel, you are a man worthy of pity. Understand the commands I speak to you, and stand in your place, for I have just been sent to you.” As he spoke this command with me, I stood trembling.
source_records.display_text: He said to me, “Daniel, you are a man worthy of pity. Understand the commands I speak to you, and stand in your place, for I have just been sent to you.” As he spoke this command with me, I stood trembling.

source_records.text: The general of the king of the Persians stood against me for twenty-one days. Then Michael, one of the foremost rulers, came to help me, and I left him there with the general of the king of the Persians.”
